Everything you need in a digital whiteboard

  • Markers and eraser

    Six colours and three thicknesses. Works with a mouse, a finger or a tablet pen.

  • Sticky notes

    Double-tap for a note, type, and drag it where it belongs. The text shrinks to fit.

  • Shapes and arrows

    Rectangles, ellipses, triangles and diamonds. Arrows stay attached when you move things.

  • An endless board

    Pan and zoom with two fingers or the mouse wheel. One tap fits everything on screen.

  • Saved as you go

    Every board is saved in this browser automatically. Close the tab and come back later.

  • Export as PNG

    Save the whole board as an image for a slide, a document or a chat.

Questions

What is an online whiteboard?

An online whiteboard is a digital white board that opens in your web browser. You draw with a mouse, a finger or a pen, add sticky notes and shapes, and save the board as an image. SiteWhiteboard is free and needs no sign-up.

Can I use it as a whiteboard on screen or on a TV?

Yes. Open the board on a computer connected to a projector, a TV or an interactive screen, or share your screen in a video call. Anyone watching sees what you draw.

Is it a good white board for kids and students?

Yes. It has no account and no ads on the drawing screen, big colour markers, and works with a finger on a tablet. Students use it for study notes, maths and mind maps.

Do I need to download a whiteboard app?

No. SiteWhiteboard works in the browser on Windows, Mac, Chromebook, Android, iPhone and iPad. Nothing to download or install.

Do I need an account?

No. Open a board and draw. There is nothing to sign up for or install.

Where are my boards saved?

In your browser, on the device you are using. They are not uploaded to a server. If you clear your browser's site data, the boards are deleted, so export anything important.

Can several people draw on the same board at once?

Not yet. A board lives on one device. To share your work, export it as a PNG and send the image.

Does it work on a phone or tablet?

Yes. Draw with a finger or a pen, and use two fingers to move and zoom the board.

Is SiteWhiteboard really free?

Yes. Ads on the site pages pay for it. The Pro plan removes the ads and adds unlimited boards, sharper exports and backups.
